lines.zh: 我的翅膀是品红的，很扎眼。
lines.en: My wings are magenta and they stand out.

lines.zh: 在一整片绿里我最显眼。
lines.en: In all this green I am the easiest to spot.
I fly a little faster than my kin.
A black band runs along my wing edge.
I sweep over the top of the flower patch.
In the sun the red turns bright.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根藤飞了三圈。
lines.en: I circle a vine three times.
The jungle's heat lifts me along.

lines.zh: 我在两棵树之间斜着飞。
lines.en: I cut diagonally between two trees.

lines.zh: 翅上的红在影子里变暗。
lines.en: The red dims inside the shadow.
I glide close to the leaf surface.
Flowers ahead; I slow down.
The petals are brighter than I am.

lines.zh: 我停在半空看了一会儿。
lines.en: I hover and look for a while.

lines.zh: 这片林子里我飞得最快。
lines.en: I am the fastest flyer in this wood.
When the wind comes, I ride it.
I fold my wings and land on a flower.
Half of the magenta still shows.
This flower is wilting a little.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅，鳞粉掉下来。
lines.en: I shake my wings and dust falls.
The patches of light are moving.
I shift one step to follow.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛应该能看见我。
lines.en: Your eyes should be able to find me.
So red, and I cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我翅上有一道旧的折痕。
lines.en: There is an old crease in my wing.

lines.zh: 我翅背上的品红比腹面亮。
lines.en: The magenta on my wing's back is brighter than below.
A petal falls beside me.
I leave it where it lies.
You found me at a glance.
Magenta is too bright among green.
Your hand comes toward me.

lines.zh: 我翅上的红映在你手上。
lines.en: The red of my wings falls on your hand.
Do not move so quickly.
I lift off and circle you once.
That is my trick.
You open your palm and wait.
I may not land there.
Rest easy; I do not bite.
A corner of the red is gone.
I fly unevenly.
Dust trails behind me.
I settle on a leaf to rest.
With this I can still fly.
The wing edge has curled.
I fold the injured side in.
I will simply fly slower.
The red part is thinnest.

lines.zh: 虞美人的蜜，我尝得出来。
lines.en: I can taste poppy nectar.
Red flowers; I like those.

lines.zh: 这朵的颜色跟我的翅很像。
lines.en: Its colour is close to my wings.
Let me land and taste it.
Step farther back.
The leaf hides the nectar from me.
Move the leaf aside.
The nectar is deep in colour.
Sweetness drifts up from the flower's heart.

lines.zh: 举低些，品红的翅够不着
lines.en: Lower it; my magenta wings cannot reach.
I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 你肩膀扫过来，我翻了个身。
lines.en: Your shoulder sweeps in and I flip over.

lines.zh: 翅上沾了你的衣料纤维。
lines.en: Fibres from your clothes stick to my wings.
I steady myself and fly again.
Your movements are too large.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的耳朵飞过去。
lines.en: I fly past your ear.
You flinch your neck.
I nearly laughed aloud.

lines.zh: 我在你指缝之间穿过去。
lines.en: I slip between your fingers.

lines.zh: 你手指一合，我已在外面。
lines.en: Your fingers close and I am already out.
That is what wings are for.

lines.zh: 我在高处绕圈，就是在等。
lines.en: I circle high up; that is how I wait.
The red one has not come.
Standing there, you block the wind.
Give me some room.
I will wait at the treetop.

lines.zh: 我翅上的红就是为了让它看见。
lines.en: The red on my wings is for it to see.
Higher up I show better.
I circle at the treetop.
See, the wind is just right.

lines.zh: 我翅上的颜色要留给它看。
lines.en: The colour on my wings is for it alone.
Something landed on the flower.
It gleams, so it is not scale dust.
I nudge it with a foreleg.
And it falls away.
I nudge it again.
This time it lands under me.
I cannot lift it, and do not care to.

lines.zh: 地上这点小东西不值得停。
lines.en: Such a trifle is not worth stopping for.
It will be lost to sight soon enough.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的灰已经落了一层。
lines.en: A layer of dust has settled on my wings.
The mouth of your net is wide.
I must get higher.

lines.zh: 品红的翅一展开你就看见了。
lines.en: Spread out, my magenta gives me away.
So I hold still first.

lines.zh: 你那根杆子举得比树高。
lines.en: You hold that pole higher than the trees.
I will not go that way.
I go around the other side.

lines.zh: 你的网挥过来的那一下太早。
lines.en: Your net swung too early.
I saw it coming.
You did not expect me to rise.
You wait under the tree with the net up.
I slip into the canopy.
The leaves block your view.
I change position while I can.
You look up to find me.

lines.zh: 你头顶那片叶，停着品红一点
lines.en: A spot of magenta rests on the leaf above you.
One step from you and I fly.
You changed where you stand.
I changed leaves too.
The underside of this leaf is darker.
Your hand catches half a wing.
Dust covers your whole hand.
I twist free of a wing edge.
That scrap of red stays in your palm.

lines.zh: 你捏住翅，我的腿就乱蹬。
lines.en: You pinch my wing and my legs kick wildly.
Do not crush it.
I still want it for flying.
Scale dust is on your fingers.
It will take a while to wash off.
And still I flew off.
I come out through a gap in the canopy.
The sun lands squarely on my wings.
A spot of red in all that green.
I take off and circle twice.
It is warm enough here.
The flowers are open below.
I turn up from the leaf's underside.
My wings open and the red spreads.

lines.zh: 这片林子在白天最热闹。
lines.en: This wood is busiest by day.
The butterflies are all flying.

lines.zh: 热浪过来，红色先焦成了黑。
lines.en: The heat comes and the red chars black.
I spin down from a height.

lines.zh: 水把翅粘平了，我挣不脱。
lines.en: Water flattens my wings; I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀得翻了几个身。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and over.

lines.zh: 一根细枝打断了我的翅尖。
lines.en: A twig snaps off my wingtip.

lines.zh: 那道光让我翅上的红褪了。
lines.en: That light fades the red on my wings.
Without nectar even the red dims.

lines.zh: 强光过后，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: After the flash I can see nothing.
The green floor vanishes at once.
